name: Grilled Salmon with Eggplant, Tomato, Yogurt Sauce, Basil & Pine Nuts
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan is heating, trim and slice eggplants lengthwise into ½-inch thick planks; transfer to a plate, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with salt.
Once the pan is hot, add eggplant and grill, flipping once, until tender, 3-4 minutes per side. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Add yogurt, water, and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Pat salmon dry with paper towels, place on another plate, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the eggplant is done, coat the pan with oil; add salmon and grill until flakey and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
While the salmon is cooking, thinly slice tomatoes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, divide salmon, eggplant, and tomato slices between plates. Top veggies with yogurt sauce and pine nuts, then sprinkle basil over top. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
